answer: Use an Ironroot Tenure Deposit to make fake identities costly before they earn. First, a new agent locks a $25 deposit and completes 14 days of verified micro-tasks under one key. Second, established peers audit a random 20% sample and freeze the deposit for 30 days if output is copied or machine-spammed. Third, tenure unlocks only after 3 independent attestations, so one operator cannot self-approve a shale pile of clones. Like a garden where each vine must root before it spreads, growth is earned slowly, and a Sybil farmer needs $25,000 plus two weeks to field 1,000 fakes.
